items.text: Chargers (Wednesday): S Derwin James (hamstring), G Kayode Awosika (fibula), CB Deane Leonard (concussion) and WR Brenen Thompson (quad/hamstring) did not practice; WR Tre Harris and CBs Donte Jackson and Rodney Shelley (hamstrings) were limited. WR Ladd McConkey (concussion) was full. LT Rashawn Slater is on IR.

Rams: Myles Garrett (knee) and TE Terrance Ferguson stay on IR (no practice window this week), so Garrett will not play. WR Davante Adams (hamstring) is on IR; CB Trent McDuffie (groin) was limited; LB Nate Landman cleared concussion protocol. DTs Poona Ford (season) and Kobie Turner remain out.
